segments.text: A runner vanishes in a Sahara sandstorm. Nine days later he walks out alive, on bat blood.
No chance. Nobody lasts nine days out there. Let's go look.
April {1994|nineteen ninety-four}. Italian policeman Mauro Prosperi runs a six-day race across the Sahara. On day four, a sandstorm swallows the trail.
He keeps running. When it clears, nothing. A helicopter passes over. It never sees him.
He finds an abandoned shrine. Bats in the tower. He drinks their blood.
Then he walks toward far mountains, at dawn and dusk, eating lizards and beetles.
Day nine. Goat tracks. A shepherd girl. He is in Algeria, almost three hundred kilometres off course.
He went back and ran that race again. I was wrong. Case closed.
